name: adb-qr-pair
title: ADB QR Pair
description: Pair and connect Android devices over wireless debugging by scanning a QR code.
author: scisaif

commands.name: adb-qr-pair
commands.title: Pair with QR Code
commands.description: Pair and connect an Android device over wireless debugging by scanning a QR code.

preferences.name: adbPath
preferences.title: ADB Path
preferences.description: Full path to adb (leave empty to auto-detect). macOS: /opt/homebrew/bin/adb — Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe

preferences.name: pairingTimeout
preferences.title: Pairing Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for the phone to scan the QR code

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
